title: Offerings and Money is five tabs and Check in is one of them

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: the offerings and money page is a joke and the check in functions cannot be found (full-page screenshot of /spaces/the-group/settings/offerings)

detail: FILED 2026-10-20 (PR 1 of 3 closes this row; PR 2 and PR 3 follow under LIVE-1176 and LIVE-1177). THE CONSEQUENCE: /settings/offerings stacked bookings, memberships, benefits, circle access and a 30 row event list into one 8,000 px scroll, and Check in had no door at all: LIVE-226 took it off Offerings, so the Check in panel link pointed at a deleted #checkin anchor and the only other entry was a card named Check-in & scanners. THE FIX (PR 1 of 3): the page is five tabs behind `?tab=` (Get paid, Bookings, Memberships, Donations, Check in), only the open tab renders, old #anchor links forward to their tab, and the console row is named Check in and opens the Check in tab. PR 2 compacts Memberships into Plans, Benefits, Circles, Event access and Members views with one-line plan rows. PR 3 adds Check in shortcuts to console Home and the phone More sheet. See ADR-1871.

verify.note: Fails on main (the body stacks every section and has no Check in tab), passes with this change.
